method: Renders r_w11 (head e97b5a1, the w10 fixes), compared with omaat_f60, f57, f7, f11, up_34. Colours are PIL box means, compared as ratios within one image. Flute relief is the p90/p10 of the column-mean luminance across a leaf band. Crops are in scratchpad/qa11a/ (v1_base.png, f60_base.png, q04_duvet.png, s4_mod.png). Code: src/09d_suite.js (357 lines).

calibration.earlier_issue: w10a MED: turned-down duvet corner buried inside the duvet
calibration.status: partly fixed. Line 307 puts the triangle on top at y 0.528, and in q04 (qa11a/q04_duvet.png) it is now visible, at L232 against the duvet's L220. It reads as a flat lighter decal, though: there is no edge shadow and no crease, while omaat_f57 shows a real fold with a shaded edge.

calibration.earlier_issue: w10b MED: duvet reads as a thick second mattress
calibration.status: fixed. Line 303 makes it about 0.05 thick at y 0.49. In q04 it now reads as a cover, though its head end is still a uniformly rounded cliff.

calibration.earlier_issue: w10a MED / w10b MED: proud taupe plinth across the doorway with the doors closed
calibration.status: not fixed in effect. The fShell block is gone, but with the doors shut line 254 still lays a plinth face under EACH closed leaf (zm-0.50..zm+0.50), and line 241's toe-kick fills the rest. v1 (qa11a/v1_base.png) therefore shows one continuous band from end to end: the under-door zone is L72, 0.84x the field. In f60 the opening under the meeting leaves is a dark void, L18 or 0.25x the field, with plinth boxes only at the two ends.

calibration.earlier_issue: w10b MED: plinth tone (taupe instead of leaf olive)
calibration.status: fixed. Line 240 sets #3c3a34. Plinth/field is v1 59/86 = 0.69, against f60 50/73 = 0.68 and f7 50/58 = 0.86.

calibration.earlier_issue: w10a LOW: grip slots move with the leaves and are too thin
calibration.status: fixed. Line 262 puts 0.10 x 0.07 slots at -L+0.22 and -0.58 in both door states (v1, s6), matching f60 and up_34.

calibration.earlier_issue: w10a LOW: keypad lighter than its module
calibration.status: fixed. Line 177 sets #2f2d2b. In q04 keypad/module is 84/104 = 0.81, against f57 83/108 = 0.77.

partly fixed. Line 19 restores contrast, but the v1 leaf band measures p90/p10 1.31 against f60's 1.98. The flat slats (line 249, 0.020 of a 0.026 pitch, groove 23 %) still read as pinstripes, not ribs.

calibration.earlier_issue: w10a LOW / w10b LOW: console module has hard flat triangular end faces
calibration.status: not fixed. Line 173 is still a straight 0.52 gExtrude, and in s4 (qa11a/s4_mod.png) the sharp wedge end faces read as a doorstop.

calibration.earlier_issue: w10a LOW: far-LOD leaves start at 0.10
w10b LOW: centre-fin strip double line / z-fight
calibration.status: fixed. Lines 95-96 centre the strips at -hx, and s3, v3 and v4 show one clean strip.

calibration.earlier_issue: w10b LOW: stipple moire on the far leaves
calibration.status: fixed. Line 19 drops the plastic layer from fFlute, and no stipple shows in q02, s1 or s6.

calibration.earlier_issue: out of scope: ottoman tweed too light, hard sun patches, plaques
calibration.status: unchanged and still out of scope. The ottoman is L~160 beige in q03 against f11's dark charcoal tweed, and the q04 bed still has hard sun lozenges.

details.detail: Proportions and plan (screen wall, wing, pier, wardrobe, ottoman, console)
details.refs: omaat_f11 vs q03 / s2; omaat_f7 vs q02

details.detail: Aisle fluted leaves, open (frame, slats, LED, pull, plinth, slot)
details.refs: omaat_f7, up_34 vs s6, s1, q02. Frame/field is 1.22 here, against f60 1.31 and f7 1.5. Relief is weak, at 1.31 against 1.98.
omaat_f60 vs v1 / v2. Under the meeting leaves there is a continuous band, not a void. The chrome foot strip is barely legible.
Cap/field is v1 197/86 = 2.29, against f60 164/73 = 2.25. The hue is the accepted middle.
f57 / f7 vs s4, q04. Module/keypad ratios are right, but the wedge end faces are hard.

details.detail: Centre pair (board, divider lowered and raised)
details.refs: omaat_f32 / f5, tpa_06 vs s3, v3, v4, q02
omaat_f57 / f58 vs q04, s5. The fold is a decal, the head end is a cliff, and the drape stops short at the foot.

issues.issue: Closed doors: a continuous plinth/toe-kick band runs under the meeting leaves. In f60 the zone under the doorway is an open dark void (the floor), with olive plinth boxes only under the outer ends, at the parked-leaf positions, each with its grip slot.
issues.evidence: qa11a/v1_base.png against qa11a/f60_base.png. Under-door/field is v1 72/86 = 0.84 and f60 18/73 = 0.25. Line 254 adds `plinth` under every leaf, including the closed ones that span the 0.64 opening (zo0..zo1 = -1.60..-0.96). Line 241's fConsoleLow toe-kick is lit to L72 in v1 and reads as plinth.
issues.fix: Line 254: build the leaf plinth only when !doorsShut. When doorsShut, add fixed plinth boxes at the parked positions so the slots keep a host, after line 262: `if (doorsShut) for (const [z0, z1] of [[-L + 0.10, zo0], [zo1, -0.46]]) B.add(gBox(0.004, ly0 - 0.01, z1 - z0), M4.trs(hx + 0.001, (ly0 - 0.01) / 2 + 0.005, (z0 + z1) / 2), plinth);`. Line 241: either delete the toe-kick, so the cabin carpet shows through as in f60, or make it a deep shadow, `{ c: '#121110', r: 0.95 }` at hx - 0.15.

issues.issue: The fluted leaves read as flat pinstripes, not the bold half-round ribs of f60 and up_34. The groove is only 23 % of the pitch.
issues.evidence: Leaf band p90/p10 is v1 1.31 against f60 1.98. Line 249 uses 0.020 slats on a 0.026 pitch. In f60 the grooves are about 35-40 % of the pitch.
issues.fix: Line 249: slat depth z 0.020 -> 0.016, which widens the groove to 0.010, about 38 %. Optionally bevel the slat with gRBox(0.006, lh - 0.07, 0.016, 0.004, 1) so it shades as a rib. Keep fFluteGap #393730 (line 19). Check moire in q02 at cabin distance.

issues.issue: The console module's ends are still hard, flat triangular wedge faces (a doorstop look). The real module (f57, f7, up_34) has radiused ends that blend into the console top.
issues.evidence: qa11a/s4_mod.png. Line 173 is one straight 0.52 gExtrude.
issues.fix: Line 173: extrude 0.44 long and add end caps at z -0.68 +/- 0.24 using the same outline flattened toward the trough, `pts.map(([x, y]) => [x, 0.655 + 0.5 * (y - 0.655)])`, each 0.04 long, so the ends step down. The cheaper alternative is gRBox(xs1 - xo, y0 - 0.655, 0.04, 0.015, 2) caps.

issues.issue: The turned-down duvet corner now shows but reads as a flat lighter decal. It has no shaded fold edge or thickness step, while f57 shows a clear fold line casting a shadow along the hypotenuse.
issues.evidence: qa11a/q04_duvet.png: the triangle is L232 against the duvet's L220, with a soft edge and no dark line.
issues.fix: Line 307: thickness 0.008 -> 0.014. Add a crease shadow along the hypotenuse: `B.add(gBox(0.43, 0.004, 0.006), M4.trs(xe - 0.21, 0.529, dz0 + 0.19 /* hypotenuse midpoint */, Math.PI / 4), { c: '#b8b4ac', r: 0.95 })`, rotated to lie along [xe-0.36, dz0..] -> [xe-0.06, dz0-0.30]. Check the sign of the rotation against the triangle orientation in q04.

issues.issue: The aisle drape stops 0.06 short of the duvet, which leaves a visible notch at the foot-end corner. The head end of the duvet is also a uniform rounded cliff, while the real cover tapers and wrinkles.
issues.evidence: q04, lower right corner of the duvet (qa11a/q04_duvet.png at about 720,500). Line 308 uses length dl - 0.06.
issues.fix: Line 308: length dl - 0.01 and r 0.006 -> 0.007. Line 303: edge 0.04 -> 0.03 with crown 0.02, so the head edge rolls down rather than standing as a cliff.

issues.issue: The leaf foot's chrome strip is barely legible. In f7 and f60 it is a bright band of about 0.015-0.018 under each leaf, the brightest line on the aisle face (f7 chrome/field 2.8x).
issues.evidence: v1 / s6 show a hairline. Lines 253 and 265 make the strip 0.008 tall and 0.004 deep.
issues.fix: Lines 253 / 265: height 0.008 -> 0.015 at y ly0 + 0.0075, with trim colour #e2e0da.

issues.issue: Out of scope, noted only: the ottoman tweed (q03, about L160 beige) against the dark charcoal-blue tweed of f11; hard sun lozenges on the bed (q04); cabin light turns the caps blue-grey in q02 (#90989f).

questions: With the doors closed, should the area under the doorway be open to the floor (as in f60, where you see carpet), or should it keep a recessed dark toe-kick for collision or picking? Either way, the leaf plinth under the closed leaves (line 254) should go.
Should the flute groove widen to about 38 % of the pitch for f60's rib relief, accepting a moire check, or stay at 23 %?
